name: new_bank_v2_eight_channel_full_candidate_leave_one_family_out

datasets.wearing: LibEMG CIILData eight-channel 200 Hz; each subject's unshifted training trials are source, four shifted domains are target; users 15-17 validation and 18-20 final
datasets.force: LibEMG ContractionIntensity eight-channel 1000 Hz; users 1-6 Ramp are source, 7-8 validation and 9-10 final across eleven conditions

classifier: parent source-only trial StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924
metric_direction: full-minus-removed positive macro-F1/log-loss-improvement/Brier-improvement means the removed family was useful
selection: fixed candidate full bank; this is a matched ablation, not a new arm selection; force full bank was not selected in its parent validation screen
endpoint: pooled macro-F1, log loss, Brier, minimum-subject and worst-condition/domain macro-F1, plus paired error changes
boundary: two public native eight-channel datasets at different rates and tasks; final comparisons descriptive; no own-device or live claim
